title: Orchestra-o1：全模态智能体编排框架
summary: 提出Orchestra-o1全模态智能体编排框架，支持文本、图像、音频、视频等多种模态的统一理解与协调。引入模态感知任务分解、在线子智能体特化和并行子任务执行机制，在OmniGAIA基准上准确率超越第二名10.3%。同时提出DA-GRPO强化学习方法，训练出的8B模型达到开源全模态智能体最优性能。
summary_en: Proposes Orchestra-o1, an omnimodal agent orchestration framework supporting unified understanding and coordination of text, image, audio, and video. Introduces modality-aware task decomposition, online sub-agent specialization, and parallel sub-task execution, surpassing the second-best approach by 10.3% accuracy on OmniGAIA. Also presents DA-GRPO, an efficient RL method, achieving SOTA among open-source omnimodal agents.
